quickPick.productName: 27 Inch UltraGear™ OLED Dual Mode QHD 540Hz or HD 720Hz 0.02ms G-Sync® Compatible DisplayPort 2.1 Gaming Monitor
quickPick.useCases: you mainly game at high refresh rates, you prefer a flat screen for esports, or you want the flexibility of dual-mode resolutions

products.summary: Offers a 240Hz refresh rate, suitable for smooth gaming experiences. Ideal for fast-paced games where lower latency matters.
Features a higher 540Hz refresh rate for extreme gaming performance. Supports resolutions up to QHD at 540Hz or HD at 720Hz.
Has a larger 33.9-inch screen with a 21:9 aspect ratio. Provides an ultra-wide field of view for cinematic experiences.
Features a compact 26.5-inch screen with a 16:9 aspect ratio. Suitable for desktop use or space-constrained environments.
Boasts a 0.03ms GtG response time. Minimizes ghosting for fast-paced content.
Offers an even faster 0.02ms GtG response time. Ideal for competitive gaming where every millisecond counts.
Reaches a typical brightness of 275 cd/m². Suitable for most indoor gaming environments.
Achieves a higher typical brightness of 335 cd/m². Performs better in brighter rooms or under various lighting conditions.

similarities: Both use OLED display technology for true blacks and vibrant colors.
Both support NVIDIA G-Sync™ Compatible for smooth gaming performance.
Both include RGB LED lighting for ambient effects.
Both have multiple HDMI and DisplayPort inputs for versatile connectivity.
Both support HDR10 for enhanced content compatibility.
